summary: Phase 3 (Agent Productivity & Call Analytics + Pending Queue + dedicated Agent login) end-to-end tested. Backend 11/11 pytest cases PASS. Frontend admin + agent flows PASS. All 6 review-request items confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/agent/analytics: role-aware query is clean (uq filters by id for caller, by active=True for mgr) and totals are summed only over filtered rows. ✓

Manager-only roster row filter `o['total'] > 0 or o['break_seconds'] > 0` correctly suppresses zero-activity users for admins but keeps callers' own row even with zero activity (caller branch sets is_mgr=False so filter is skipped). ✓
/api/agent/live and /api/agent/status-logs correctly enforced via require_roles('admin','manager') — caller hits 403 (verified). ✓

Frontend CallCenter.jsx tab gating via isMgr is correct: admin sees Agent Analytics/Agent Live Status/Break Reports; caller sees only My Stats. AgentAnalytics component is reused for both with isMgr prop toggling the header column 'Agent' vs 'Me' and the trophy icon. ✓

Pending Queue tab calls /api/calls?status=queued and renders via CallList — admin sees all queued (3 rows incl. one for Test Agent ph 9874975823), caller sees only own queued (confirmed via backend test + UI screenshot). ✓
Date input on Agent Analytics — when changed, reloads via load() and renders 'No agent activity for this date.' empty state on days with no activity. ✓
Minor cosmetic: 'Connect Rate' header column text may visually wrap; consider tighter column widths on smaller viewports. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin all 6 tabs + Agent Analytics with 6 cards/4 rows/trophy/date-reload; agent 4 tabs visible + 3 manager tabs hidden + My Stats 1 row 'Test Agent' with all 10 metrics + Pending Queue renders queued call)
